adam.assumes: Page views on preview deployments, including every end-to-end test run against a preview, do not count toward the 50,000 Web Analytics events a month that the account's projects share on Hobby.
adam.if_wrong: Test runs use up the quota, and Vercel stops recording production visitors without telling anyone. Fix: render Analytics only when VERCEL_ENV is production.

changed_steps.step: Tell whether this job stopped at its time limit

lesson.summary: The run never reached the step #648 changed: "Tell whether this job stopped at its time limit" runs only when the job is cancelled, and this run succeeded, so the step was skipped and nothing needs doing.
lesson.detail: Pull request #648 changed one step in install-workflows.yml. That step works out the job's elapsed minutes with jq instead of `date -d` (decisions H632b), so it also works on a Mac. The step has `if: cancelled()`. Run 45064560627 finished with success, so the step was skipped and its log is empty. This first run could not show whether the change works. The factory's own tests already cover it: the `stopped` helper in the tests runs this step as a cancelled job would. Adam's one unchecked assumption, about whether Vercel Web Analytics counts page views on preview deployments, concerns a project template, not this workflow, so this run cannot confirm or refute it.
